items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday, second straight DNP after exiting Week 4 early; week-to-week and not expected to play Week 5 in London vs JAX.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 4; consecutive DNPs confirmed by team and Schefter.
items.implication: Likely OUT for Week 5; major RB workload available.
items.opportunity: Lead backfield role opens fully with Bigsby also on IR.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for second straight day; trending toward missing Week 5 vs JAX after missing Week 4.
items.implication: High chance OUT; targets redistribute in PHI pass game.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs/TE including Dontayvion Wicks (limited hamstring).

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury; Friday practice looms large for availability in Sunday night game at ATL.
items.why: Ankle injury; missed practice, Friday key per Schefter.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk for SNF; backup implications for BAL offense.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Huntley/likely elevated; Flowers/Andrews/Likely usage shifts.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot injury (plantar fasciitis); coach says will miss multiple weeks.
items.why: Re-aggravation confirmed by coach McCarthy via Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR targets open significantly.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and others see full target share boost.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: With Barkley and Bigsby OUT/IR, 'it's gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville'; primary Eagles RB opportunity Week 5.
items.why: Barkley week-to-week DNP, Bigsby IR core surgery; Shipley next man up per pod.
items.implication: High-priority waiver/add for RB volume vs JAX; three-down potential.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone in depleted PHI backfield.
items.conflict: Some external warnings on Shipley efficiency/YPC history.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; potential limited/OUT risk impacts BUF WR targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for other BUF pass-catchers if sits.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot); second straight DNP after aggravating injury in Week 4.
items.why: Foot injury aggravated; consecutive DNPs on official report.
items.implication: Doubtful/OUT lean for vs DEN; targets to Quentin Johnston/others.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for LAC WRs.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift limited Thursday (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight (thumb/toe).
items.implication: CHI RB committee cloudy; Swift still lead but volume risk.
items.opportunity: If both limited, other backs elevated.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8 for Week 5; target-hog with red-zone volume vs struggling defense.
items.implication: Strong start; WR1 upside this week.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + soft run defense, boosted by possible Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Defense carved by RBs + CIN injury context for script.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Chase Brown underperforming xFP so far.

items.text: Levitan xFP: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming theirs so far.
items.why: Sortable expected vs actual fantasy points data through four weeks.
items.implication: Sustain or regression watch; Bijan/Kyren buy signals on efficiency, Jeanty/Chase Brown sell/hold on underperf.
items.opportunity: Opportunity-adjusted value; prioritize volume over raw points.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
items.why: Back injury on Titans Thursday report.
items.implication: Monitor; potential snap reduction vs HOU.
items.opportunity: If limited further, other TEN WRs benefit.

items.text: Berry loves Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15) and Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) on coverage/positional matchup edges.
Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17); tough matchups, thin roles, usage concerns (Addison injury wrinkle).
